name: pie-chart
title: Pie chart
description: A React pie chart for part-to-whole at a glance: up to 6 slices, leader-line labels that never collide and an always-complete legend. Animated, accessible.
author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>
docs:
Pie chart: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/charts/pie-chart

Installed in components/sheenui/charts/. Import (use your components alias):
import { PieChart, PieTable } from "@/components/sheenui/charts/pie-chart";

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
